post_training_mechanism_diagnostics.selection: First32 eval examples in immutable cohort order, selected before results. Report complete aggregates on972 eval examples; retain improving/degrading/unchanged units without favorable-case selection.
post_training_mechanism_diagnostics.frozen_interventions: Within the cubic-trained final state, hold keys, class queries, utilities and bias fixed while swapping native/coherent/initial-dephased/linear routing. Separate this local intervention from independently trained condition comparisons.
post_training_mechanism_diagnostics.coordinate_ceiling: For normalized keys, M=Psi Psi-dagger, B=M+N*epsilon*I and F_t=psi_t psi_t-dagger+epsilon*I. Native pure/mixed attention at t is bounded by lambda_max(B^-1/2 F_t B^-1/2). Exceedance is sufficient, not necessary, for fixed-key region separation.
post_training_mechanism_diagnostics.readout_ceiling: For each class utility vector u, E_u=sum_t u_t F_t. Native logit without bias lies between the minimum and maximum eigenvalues of B^-1/2 E_u B^-1/2. Apply corresponding transported effects for coherent and dephased controls. These generalized-Rayleigh tools are known; the diagnostic is not a new theorem or an automatic utility guarantee.
competing_explanations: A coordinate/logit range expansion can occur without improving held-out labels.
Jointly trained keys and values may adapt; fixed-state swaps alone do not mediate total trained-method gain.
Linear transport may help constrained sample-shared learned queries despite its unrestricted fixed-key region null.
Failure to observe a coordinate ceiling exceedance does not prove complete attention-region equality.
post_training_mechanism_diagnostics.trace_scope: Source-linked synthetic fixtures and compact real-unit diagnostics; do not relabel this as sample-trace.v2 unless every required lineage/value/semantic gate is separately satisfied.

persistence_and_recovery.stopped_result: After all declared evidence consumers close, an inconclusive/stopped exploration retains Git code and compact reports; no automatic checkpoint/cache COS upload and no unapproved deletion.
persistence_and_recovery.local_PC: No datasets, checkpoints or package wheels; small code and evidence records only.

formal_and_L5_route: Any new complete-data experiment belongs to the collaborator through main->1.1->audited reports, with first single seed then predeclared replication only after audit.
